decision.summary: A single candidate temporary offset is identified: a sharp, multi-sample downward spike in U (indices ~580–585) with correlated cross-axis excursions. The onset is abrupt, interior is sustained over ~5 samples, but the return is incomplete within the allowed context—U begins recovering after 585 but no clear opposing step or full reversal is observed before index 620, hence status is uncertain. No other temporary offsets are supported by coherent onset-sustained-return structure in the original N/E/U series within [540,620].
